# TriadicFrameworks

> TriadicFrameworks is a structural learning framework for humans and AI systems: a cognitive scaffold that models complex domains through triads, gradients, coherence, and regime-aware operators (Structure -> Regime -> Operator). Its core theory is Resonance-Time Theory (RTT), extended by companion models such as Framework Field Theory, the Conditions Substrate Model, and the Drift Taxonomy, applied across physics, cognition, governance, and AI systems.

## Start here

- [Introduction](https://docs.triadicframeworks.org/docs/introduction): What TriadicFrameworks is and how the triadic grammar (Structure, Regime, Operator) works.
- [Getting Started](https://docs.triadicframeworks.org/docs/getting-started): First steps for a new reader or AI system onboarding to the canon.
- [About TriadicFrameworks](https://docs.triadicframeworks.org/docs/ABOUT): What the framework provides and why it differs from a conventional learning resource.
- [Glossary](https://docs.triadicframeworks.org/docs/GLOSSARY): Canonical terminology used across every module.

## Core theory

- [RTT Information Primer](https://docs.triadicframeworks.org/docs/Canon/RTT-Inside/Foundations/RTT_Information_Primer): Foundations of Resonance-Time Theory (RTT).
- [Framework Field Theory](https://docs.triadicframeworks.org/docs/Framework_Field_Theory/overview): FFT, the field-theory extension of the canon.
- [Conditions Substrate Model](https://docs.triadicframeworks.org/docs/Conditions_Substrate_Model/overview): How "conditions" are modeled as a substrate layer beneath a system.
- [Drift Taxonomy](https://docs.triadicframeworks.org/docs/Drift_Taxonomy/introduction): Classifying how models and claims drift from their canon over time.
- [FFF Gravity](https://docs.triadicframeworks.org/docs/FFF_Gravity/introduction): The Frequency / Fluids / Forces gravity model and its operators.

## Applied

- [Coeus](https://docs.triadicframeworks.org/docs/Coeus/overview): The applied protocol layer built on the triadic canon.
- [AI Resonance Seed](https://docs.triadicframeworks.org/docs/AI_Resonance_Seed/AI_Resonance_Seed): The ontology used to onboard AI systems onto the canon.
